verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents creating and managing API Access Tokens that grant access to resources like CKS clusters and VPCs, plus per-cluster kubeconfigs. It also supports exchanging an API token for temporary AI Object Storage credentials and group-based bucket policies, which give some scoping at the storage layer. Nothing shows tokens themselves being permission-scoped or least-privilege, or any agent or service-account identity. Missing for 10: token-level permission scoping or roles, service/machine identities for agents, token expiry/rotation controls beyond storage credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration.
